close_reason: Already defended: mailbox.rs lines 714-730 have extensive comments explaining the two-pass strategy, role-swap atomicity, and why the two passes are needed.
description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_set: the two-pass update strategy (pass 1 = role-vacating patches, pass 2 = role-claiming patches) correctly handles the case where a single request needs to swap roles between two mailboxes (A vacates inbox, B claims inbox). Without this, map iteration order could cause B to fail because A has not yet vacated. The roles_actually_vacated set tracks only successfully-vacated roles, so a failed vacate does not release the role to a subsequent claim in the same request. This is a non-obvious correctness property that a future contributor might 'simplify' by removing the two-pass structure. Defend it.
title: Two-pass Mailbox update loop handles role swap atomically
